test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Why did the grandmother accompany her grandson to school every day?

options.text: To keep him safe from stray dogs
To read scriptures in the temple while he studied
To spend more time with him
To ensure he wouldn’t run away to play in the streets

solution: The correct answer is '**To read scriptures in the temple while he studied**.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The first sentence of the second paragraph says "***My grandmother always went to school with me because the school was attached to the temple***'' (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का पहला वाक्य कहता है मेरी दादी हमेशा मेरे साथ स्कूल जाती थी क्योंकि स्कूल मंदिर से जुड़ा हुआ था) and the third sentence of the second paragraph says "*While **the children sat in rows on either side of the verandah singing the alphabet or the prayer** in a chorus, my **grandmother sat inside reading the scriptures***''. (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का तीसरा वाक्य कहता है जब बच्चे बरामदे के दोनों ओर पंक्तियों में बैठकर वर्णमाला गा रहे थे या कोरस में प्रार्थना कर रहे थे, मेरी दादी शास्त्र पढ़ने अंदर बैठ गईं) • From the above sentence, we can say that the grandmother accompany her grandson to school every day to read scriptures in the temple while he studied. (उपरोक्त वाक्य से, हम कह सकते हैं कि दादी अपने पोते के साथ प्रतिदिन स्कूल में मंदिर में धर्मग्रंथों को पढ़ने के लिए जाती हैं, जबकि बच्चे अध्ययन करते हैं) Hence, the only possible answer is option 2. 72:T8ea, The correct answer is '**Religious**.'
